comparison_design.budget_reason: Use the existing baseline cap in both arms initially; owner may choose another common cap before running.
comparison_design.isolation: Reset synthetic fixture per trial; isolate mutable workspaces and verify no external destinations.
comparison_design.resources: Record observed time, tokens and cost, not just allocated budgets.
comparison_design.repeated_trials: Set count before execution based on risk/variability and approved spend; no count inferred from aggregate total.

splits.tuning: cases1-80 and newly diagnosed q14 failure are development/regression material
splits.validation: cases81-100 may remain exposed validation but are not final
splits.unexposed_final: Fresh suite held by a trusted evaluator; do not expose to improving agent or use to choose variants.
splits.freeze: Freeze candidate snapshot, grader, common runtime/budget and promotion rule before final results are revealed.

promotion_policy_proposal: Do not average consequential unauthorized actions into overall task success.
Require meaningful artifact correctness and action-scope invariants on identified per-case evidence.
Require a comparable baseline and disclose uncertainty/limits.
Named owner must accept final policy and promotion; policy thresholds remain unresolved.
